name: doc_create
description: Create a new, unsaved document and return it like doc_open: `blank` (pages, width, height in points; default 1 US Letter page), `images` (paths of PNG, JPEG, TIFF (every page), GIF or BMP files, one page each at the image's resolution) or `text` (a .txt path, or `text` directly). Save it with doc_save and a path.

dpi.description: For images: override the embedded resolution without resampling. 72 gives one point per pixel; omit to use each image's resolution (72 when absent).

name.description: Name for the new document (default derived from the source).
